blocking_gates: USDJPY 1m source identity and broker mapping remain unverified.
GBPJPY source timestamps were naive before UTC localization; the source timezone assumption remains uncertified.
Both snapshots are OHLC without historical bid/ask. The source tests BuyStop against ask and SellStop against bid and manages long/short trailing stops using bid/ask.
No broker contract size, tick value, point, lot step, minimum lot, margin rule, account currency or JPY conversion feed is verified. The frozen 1 percent risk sizing cannot be reconciled.
CADJPY is absent. The two-pair data cannot validate the frozen three-pair claim.
Source code permits both opposite pending orders in one hour and has no OCO. Same-bar dual-trigger handling and shared FX account behavior are not certified for this broker proxy.
Native NEXT_BAR STOP gap behavior is proven in a synthetic capability test only; no market-data strategy backtest was run.
